# ZenTao Bug 6911: rectification task PDF signature images
Bug 6911 was a resolved/fixed web/G-end variant of the same rectification-task PDF signature issue later reported as ZenTao bug 6964.

## Issue and identity
- Title: "检查记录：整改任务单需要带出签字内容" ("Inspection record: rectification task list must include signature content").
- Bug 6911 was resolved/fixed by 2026-11-25 10:13; bug 6964 was opened at 2026-11-25 10:42, 29 minutes later.
- Both bugs targeted the same backend downloadRectifyTaskPdf method in zhi2-evaluation and the same blank PDF signature-field root cause; 6964 was the management-end APP duplicate of 6911's web/G-end issue.

## Fix
- Remote commit 4d24ee7 for bug 6911 added the signature-in-PDF implementation to StdEvalCheckRecordServiceImpl.downloadRectifyTaskPdf (about 126 lines).
- The implementation added createPdfSignImageCell and downloadFileBytes, plus getSignImage reusing downloadFileBytes, to embed signature images in the two rectification task PDF fields.
- Remote branch develop/v2.6.2-suzhufang-dev already contained this fix at HEAD 0b84b64; StdEvalCheckRecordServiceImpl.java:1141-1142 called createPdfSignImageCell.
- A later local implementation for bug 6964 duplicated this fix and was dropped to avoid overwriting the already-merged tested implementation.

## Verification and relation
- The remote fix compiled successfully on 2026-11-25 with mvn -q -pl zhi2-evaluation/zhi2-evaluation-server -am -DskipTests compile, EXIT=0.
- Bug 6964 was subsequently written back as resolved/fixed with a comment documenting the 6911 relation.

# ZenTao Bug 6964: blank signatures in rectification task PDF
ZenTao bug 6964 was closed on 2026-11-25 after confirming that the required backend signature-in-PDF fix had already been merged for duplicate bug 6911.

## Issue evidence
- Link: http://zentao-biz.zhi.com/index.php?m=bug&f=view&bugID=6964; initial state was assignedTo=tiany, status=active, no comments, steps 573 characters; defect type designdefect, not browser-reproducible, so no agent-browser gate.
- The management-end APP downloads the rectification task PDF through /{checkRecordId}/rectifyTask/pdf; backend StdEvalCheckRecordServiceImpl.downloadRectifyTaskPdf in zhi2-evaluation (about lines 1032-1136) generated it with iText and hardcoded two blank signature cells.
- Signatures are stored in T_STD_EVAL_CHECK_RECORD.SIGN_COMPANY_LEADER and SIGN_INSPECTOR; DTO via BeanUtil.copyProperties carried signCompanyLeader and signInspector but did not embed them in the PDF; the requirement was to show both images in the two signature fields, matching G-end behavior.
- G-end RectifyTaskPreview.vue already embedded signCompanyLeader and signInspector as images; real signatures are relative paths (/zhi2-dev/...), so backend retrieval must use RemoteFileService.downloadByFilePath with Feign timeout/fallback, not raw HTTP.
- AssessmentRecordServiceImpl.generateHtml and generateAttachmentHtml also lacked signatures; final confirmed target was the iText PDF method.

## Plan and handoff
- Plan review PASS (86/100, no P0); user confirmed full scope: implementation, commit/push, and ZenTao writeback.
- Approved plan: D:/plan/苏住房后端/session-ecd3a89b-7ce6-4867-983c-4530cf911c8f.md (sha256 98edbbb0…).
- Baseline Maven compile EXIT=0; submodule zhi2-evaluation was clean on branch develop/v2.6.2-suzhufang-dev; root cause, G-end reference, plan approval, baseline compile, and three imports were already completed before handoff.
- Implementation triggered a P0 handoff waiting for the next hop; handoff document was D:/plan/苏住房后端/HANDOFF-CHAIN-bug6964整改任务单签字带出-hop1-20261125-1155.md; chain_id=bug6964整改任务单签字带出, hop=1, maxHops=10; section 4 had six non-empty tasks, so the chain continued rather than terminating, with a new_once auto-continuation scheduled for 2026-11-25 11:57:39.
- Pending handoff tasks were to add RemoteFileService bean, replace two createPdfBlankCell calls with createPdfSignImageCell, add private createPdfSignImageCell retrieval/scaling/fallback, compile, commit/push with parent gitlink, and write back to ZenTao 6964.

## Resolution and repository state
- On 2026-11-25, an initial local implementation and commit e840446327aa58ee7f62b8eb180055360b83e2dd were created, but rebase revealed two remote new commits, including 4d24ee7 which had already merged the same fix.
- Bug 6911 ("检查记录：整改任务单需要带出签字内容", web/G-end variant) was resolved/fixed at 2026-11-25 10:13; bug 6964 was opened at 2026-11-25 10:42, 29 minutes later; both target the same StdEvalCheckRecordServiceImpl.downloadRectifyTaskPdf code and root cause.
- The duplicate local commit was dropped with rebase --abort and reset --hard to remote HEAD 0b84b64; no duplicate code was pushed, avoiding overwrite of the colleague's tested fix.
- Remote HEAD 0b84b64 contains the fix in StdEvalCheckRecordServiceImpl.java:1141-1142, calling createPdfSignImageCell with downloadFileBytes/getSignImage; the worktree was clean and aligned to remote HEAD.
- Compile of the remote fix passed with mvn -q -pl zhi2-evaluation/zhi2-evaluation-server -am -DskipTests compile returning EXIT=0; parent gitlink was not updated because parent still points to 45bd4cdc while submodule HEAD is 0b84b64, parent had 11 dirty files in common-framework/service-expand, and separate confirmation is required for parent sync.

# zhi2-mobile-query-h5-c
Suzhou Housing flood-control C-end mobile query H5, uni-app + Vue3; GitLab `suzhufang-fe/zhi2-mobile-query-h5-c`, main branch `dev`, local directory `D:\repository\苏住房防汛C端`.

## Pages and features
- `home/index.vue` (`.scroll-tabs` + `BottomNav`): 2026-11-04 C-end information feed home (carousel/todos/learning corner/news list); 2026-11-14 added skeleton screens and data mapping (banner uses API title/image, fallback brand copy when empty; todos use homepage task summary and preserve source/date/category tags; list uses C-end API), pushed `fix/home-visual-20261114` (`a8f6c97652f4ae242135198bc2e3e335f73b527d`); among the bottom five items, only "我的" was renamed "个人中心".
- 2026-11-25 ZenTao 6955: remove MOCK, distinguish B-end display, connect real data; see "ZenTao bug 6955 remove MOCK".
- `mine/index.vue`: `.user-card` blue gradient, `.menu-card` white, `.mine-body` skeleton screen; data composed by `portalData.ts fetchMine`.
- `data/index.vue`: statically injects `ref-assets.ts` design DOM `REF_SEC0~REF_SEC5` (auto-generated, do not hand-edit); area labels and metrics were hardcoded, now only unique title text is bound (area/area size/enterprise count); detail subgrid and property assessment remain design drafts because backend APIs are missing.
- `project-check/form/index.vue`: ZenTao 6931 evaluation-level selector uncommented and level transmitted (3 frontend files uncommitted; local draft reloads questions after level change and `startCheck` transmits level); backend root cause, commit, and dual-end acceptance are in "ZenTao bug 6931 evaluation level transmission".

## Login and requirements
- Login `useFloodStore().login` calls `/v2.0/security/auth/login`, returns `nickName/userName/userId/phone/roles`; captcha placeholder is "请输入图形验证码"; token is stored in `flood-token-v1` (`request.ts` `setToken`), login user in `flood-login-user-v1` (including roles/roleKeys/deptId); injecting both keys simulates login state.
- 2026-11-16 requirement: clicking pre-flood/during-flood/post-flood popups selects "property management area" and "warning item"; the list header shows the selections, and popup style follows the provided HTML.

## Build and workflow
- One git worktree per task (no `node_modules`, junction points to the main repo); after verification merge back to `dev` and clean up; background build exit 0 produces `dist`; before commit run `worktree-snapshot` for isolation and `submodule-commit` to commit/push.
- Default `bun run build demo` (`usePortalApi()` false uses seed data); remote `uni build -m test` uses `.env.test`; bun is the package manager, there is no ESLint CLI, Vitest covers `tests/**/*.test.ts`, and the remote mock request locks bizState→status mapping.
- Pitfalls: `onShow` must be imported from `@dcloudio/uni-app` (from `vue` gives TS2305); browser needs a hash query to bypass old lazy chunks (for example `pages-home-index.*.js`), hash changes do not trigger page `onShow`, and role-switch verification requires a full reload; typecheck errors in `store/user.ts`, `utils/index.ts`, and `responseDecrypt.ts` are pre-existing.

## APIs, deployment, and notes
- `usePortalApi()` requests lists only when the API base is non-empty and a token exists; preview builds set `VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api` and intercept responses; deployment must set `VITE_API_BASE_URL` or `VITE_AUTH_BASE_URL`; learning/news come from fixtures and field mapping has not been validated against the real API.
- request utility: `raw:true` returns the `{code,msg,data}` wrapper for the caller to unpack, while default behavior unwraps data; `portal.ts detail()` unwraps the wrapper; `GET /v2.0/system/region/list(parentCode=320500)` requires no login and returns `JsonResult<List<SysRegionVo>>` (items `{regionName,regionCode,level,parentCode}`); on 2026-11-11 the same pattern added `getKeyData/getBenefitData/getRepairData/getSunshineOverview/getRegionList`.
- 2026-11-24 rescue work order detail issue was an unpacked `raw:true` wrapper plus inconsistent log/region field names; the fix plan was approved (see "Rescue work order detail"); local preview `localhost:8162` reads `dist` directly.
- nginx 8095 upstream is the remote test server `192.168.1.31`; local backend changes usually do not affect device verification; local backend `mvn compile` first requires installing sibling API jars (zhi2-property-api, common-framework-api) into the local Maven repository.
